resources.string: Use your face to unlock your phone. Use your fingerprint, PIN, pattern, or password when an app requires authentication.
Set up Face Unlock to unlock your phone.
Your organization has disabled Face Unlock. Contact your administrator for more information.
Enroll in good lighting with your face uncovered. If you usually wear glasses, wear them during setup.
Looking at your phone may unlock it unintentionally. Someone who looks like you, or someone holding your phone up to your face, may also unlock it.
Face Unlock is less secure than a strong PIN, pattern, or password. On this phone, it cannot authorize purchases or authenticate you in apps.
Face the front camera and keep your eyes unobstructed during setup.

The front camera captures your face during setup. Face Unlock compares it with the enrolled face when you unlock your phone. A PIN, pattern, or password is still required after a restart and whenever Android requires it.
You can manage or remove enrolled faces in Settings. Removing a face prevents it from being used for Face Unlock.
